title: Talking-head footage to a Reel or Short
what_it_does: Skill with a first-3-seconds gate, a plan schema with validator, footage validator, quality gates, reference-reel analysis, and an EDITING-PLAYBOOK of pacing, layouts, captions, B-roll order and sound. Defaults to 1080x1920 and verifies each aspect separately.
when_to_use: The core 'make a Reel from my footage' flow.
why: MIT with tests; the most complete HyperFrames-native short-form recipe found. Moving B-roll through Kie.ai is optional and paid, so leave that step out by default.
